cohort: 80 preterm infants with birth weight less than 1500 g (25-32 weeks of gestation)
finding: Thiol levels increased over the 3 weeks, while disulfide and disulfide/thiol ratios initially increased in the first week and then decreased in the third week, suggesting a shift towards a more antioxidant state over time.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery had no effect on baseline thiol-disulfide homeostasis.
